
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/grey-wolf/p/22749811" title="发布于 2026-08-29 09:03">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">windows codex更新失败如何处理</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="背景">背景</h1>
<p>发现家里电脑的codex版本有点旧了，想着更新下：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260829073858077.png" alt="image-20260829073858077" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="尝试">尝试</h1>
<h2 id="应用内更新">应用内更新</h2>
<p>直接尝试更新会报错，因为这台电脑改注册表啥的，把各种自动更新都禁用了的：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260829074008799.png" alt="image-20260829074008799" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260829074034830.png" alt="image-20260829074034830" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="本地microsoft-store">本地Microsoft store</h2>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260829074215622.png" alt="image-20260829074215622" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="microsoft-store网页">Microsoft store网页</h2>
<p><a href="https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9plm9xgg6vks?hl=zh-CN" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9plm9xgg6vks?hl=zh-CN</a></p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260829074324221.png" alt="image-20260829074324221" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>这边直接点下载后，拿到一个：</p>
<p>ChatGPT Installer.exe</p>
<p>打开提示已经安装了：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260829074425923.png" alt="image-20260829074425923" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="参考网上文章进行处理">参考网上文章进行处理</h1>
<p>昨天才看到一篇文章讲这块：</p>
<p><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/janbar/p/22738716" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/janbar/p/22738716</a></p>
<p>使用官方 MSIX 安装包手动更新 Codex</p>
<p>这篇文章我看了下，核心就是从以下地址下载两个东西：</p>
<p><a href="https://persistent.oaistatic.com/codex-app-prod/ChatGPT-x64.msix" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://persistent.oaistatic.com/codex-app-prod/ChatGPT-x64.msix</a></p>
<p><a href="https://persistent.oaistatic.com/codex-app-prod/ChatGPT-arm64.msix" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://persistent.oaistatic.com/codex-app-prod/ChatGPT-arm64.msix</a></p>
<p>说真的，这个域名看着还不敢下，万一下了个木马就坑惨了。</p>
<p>网上仔细查了查这个域名，看着还好。</p>
<p>不过还是不放心，不过后来在官网找到了地址，和上面地址是一样的：</p>
<p><a href="https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/enterprise/windows-deployment" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/enterprise/windows-deployment</a></p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260829081522886.png" alt="image-20260829081522886" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>这两个链接就是指向最新版本的包的，每一天去这个链接下载，下下来的都可能不一样。</p>
<p>我这边下载下来了，ChatGPT-x64.msix，大概780M</p>
<h2 id="更新">更新</h2>
<p>先把老版本程序关了，然后直接双击打开就行，会看到下面这个：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260829082541445.png" alt="image-20260829082541445" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>结果我这点了更新后，正好赶上吃饭，吃完饭回来，发现也没啥反应。</p>
<p>尝试命令行安装：</p>
<p>打开powershell，执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">Add-AppxPackage -Path C:\Users\xxx\Downloads\ChatGPT-x64.msix（这里是你自己路径）
</code></pre>
<p>执行时，会有个进度条，就算失败了，也会提示原因：（比如我下面这个失败，就是说老版本没有关）</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260829085014117.png" alt="image-20260829085014117" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>查看正在运行的进程：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell"> Get-Process ChatGPT,Codex
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260829085301584.png" alt="image-20260829085301584" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>然后关了老版本重试就好了，再查。</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260829085513241.png" alt="image-20260829085513241" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>然后重新安装即可：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell"> Add-AppxPackage -Path C:\Users\111\Downloads\ChatGPT-x64.msix
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260829085145919.png" alt="image-20260829085145919" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="一键安装命令">一键安装命令</h1>
<p>上述的参考文章中，这个也不错:</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$path = "$env:TEMP\ChatGPT-x64.msix"
 
Invoke-WebRequest `
    -Uri "https://persistent.oaistatic.com/codex-app-prod/ChatGPT-x64.msix" `
    -OutFile $path
 
Add-AppxPackage -Path $path
</code></pre>
<h1 id="参考文档">参考文档</h1>
<p><a href="https://help.openai.com/en/articles/9982051-using-the-chatgpt-windows-app" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://help.openai.com/en/articles/9982051-using-the-chatgpt-windows-app</a></p>
<p><a href="https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/enterprise/windows-deployment" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/enterprise/windows-deployment</a></p>
